reports.title: Ichor Holdings, Ltd. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect the following:

Low-End | Mid-Point | High-End
Revenue | $345 million | $355 million | $365 million
GAAP diluted EPS | $0.50 | $0.55 | $0.60
Non-GAAP diluted EPS | $0.65 | $0.70 | $0.75

This outlook for non‑GAAP diluted EPS excludes amortization of intangible assets of approximately $1.9 million and share-based compensation expense of approximately $4.0 million, as well as the related income tax effects. Non-GAAP diluted EPS should be considered in addition to, but not as a substitute for, our financial information presented in accordance with GAAP.
